messages:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] GPU memory paging surge detected on prod-cluster-7, auto-escalated to oncall. metric: gpu_mem_paging_rate > 80% for 3m :rotating_light:
Ryan (oncall): I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. any customer reports?
Julie (pm): We've got 3 customers seeing 5xxs on generation endpoints, reported ~11:12 UTC.
Elena (infra): grabbing live logs, running `curl -s http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=gpu_mem_paging` and pulling the pod list.
Mike (sre): quick note — I've seen this pattern when KV cache fragmentation spikes during large batch storms.
Elena (infra): paste of `nvidia-smi dmon` snapshot:
```
GPU   MemUsed MiB  MemFree MiB  FBFrag MiB  AllocFailures
0     48120        520         6144         412
1     47100        1540        2048         18
```
Elena (infra): also runtime logs show repeated OOM-ish allocation fallbacks and pagewalks: `alloc failed, falling back to device paging`
Ryan (oncall): timeline so far: 11:10 spike in batch_size, 11:11 first errors, 11:12 P95 latency jump, 11:13 paging alerts.
Mike (sre): hypotheses: 1) KV cache fragmentation + large batch windows -> allocator can't find contiguous chunk 2) sudden bump in long-context requests invalidating prefix cache causing big allocs 3) kernel scheduling + multi-tenancy noise.
Julie (pm): impacts: 3 customers, several hundred requests failed, some retries caused backpressure. need customer impact note for support.
Elena (infra): dumping kvcache stats from runtime admin endpoint:
```
/kvcache/stats => total_entries=1_246_000, used_bytes=34_100_234_112, fragmentation_bytes=1_024_512_000, hot_evictions=2_134
hot_set_distribution: 78% small keys, 22% large entries
```
Mike (sre): fragmentation ~1GB on a 34GB cache isn't huge but seems correlated with contiguous allocation failures (see alloc failures count).
Ryan (oncall): immediate mitigations we can try: A) reduce incoming max batch tokens to 256 via gate B) enable aggressive kv-evict-sweep (runtime flag) C) rollout fallback model (smaller memory footprint)
Elena (infra): I'm pushing a temporary config change to rate-limit batch_size at the load-balancer (rule rollout id 4782). Pls hold on other changes until we see effect.
Ops Bot: config-change: batch_size.max_tokens=256 applied to prod-cluster-7 by Elena at 11:18 UTC :white_check_mark:
Mike (sre): also enabling kv-evict-sweep (flag kvcache.sweep_immediate=true) on two nodes to test — doing a canary now.
Elena (infra): canary logs show immediate drop in alloc failures on node0, node1 still noisy.
Elena (infra): can we get a heap/fragment map from runtime? grabbing slab allocator dump.
```
slab_map: free_runs=42, largest_contiguous=512MB, avg_free_run=12MB
pagewalk_ops: 1200/s -> 300/s after canary
```
Mike (sre): good signal — pagewalk ops down ~4x after kv sweep/cap on batch. hypothesis gaining traction: fragmentation + large contiguous allocation needs causing device paging.
Julie (pm): Support note draft: "We observed elevated latency and errors on generation endpoints due to backend memory fragmentation and paging. Mitigation applied: temporary batch-size cap and cache sweep; customers served by cluster-7 may see reduced throughput while we stabilize."
Ryan (oncall): assigning actions: Elena -> continue rollout of batch cap across cluster, Mike -> validate kvcache sweep safety and schedule full sweep, Julie -> send customer advisory, I'll follow-up with post-incident timeline.
Elena (infra): rolling batch cap to remaining nodes (progress 6/8) at 11:27 UTC.
Mike (sre): full kvcache sweep scheduled at 11:32 UTC, will monitor for regressions.
Elena (infra): after full rollout, metrics show paging rate down to 12%, 5xxs back to baseline.
Ryan (oncall): ok stabilizing. last: collect artifacts for RCA: nvidia-smi dumps, slab maps, kvcache dumps, request traces for spike windows. please upload to incident channel thread.
Julie (pm): customer impact: Customers A,B,C had 4-7% error rates during 11:10–11:28 UTC, we will credit incident minutes per SLA.
Mike (sre): RCA notes in-thread (working): root cause likely a confluence: small-but-critical KV cache fragmentation combined with a transient traffic pattern of very large batches that required contiguous allocations; allocator fell back to device paging causing severe perf degradation. Mitigations: config guardrails (batch caps), improved kvcache compaction/sweep, add allocation failure telemetry and early fallback to smaller model variant.
Ryan (oncall): I'm marking incident as mitigated at 11:30 UTC. final tasks: Mike - write postmortem hypothesis + tests, Elena - add automatic batch cap when paging rate > 50%, Julie - finalize customer comms.
Ops Bot: incident_status: mitigated by config rollouts at 11:30 UTC. incident_ticket: INC-2026-8943.
Mike (sre): adding follow-ups: schedule a KV defragmentation job, add unit to CI that simulates large-batch contig-alloc heavy load.
Elena (infra): uploading logs bundle to /shared/incidents/INC-2026-8943/logs.tar.gz
Ryan (oncall): thanks all. we can close thread once postmortem is in docs. :thumbsup:
